setup.zh: 青鼎从海泥里升起来。鼎身上铸着海、岱山和一轮初升的日——青州的一切。潮停在它脚下，等着。
setup.en: The Cauldron of Qing rises from the sea mud. Cast on its body are the sea, Mount Tai and a rising sun — everything of Qing. The tide waits at its feet.

text.zh: 我想起第三件事。放我进的那水，是咸的——是海，是这片海。那只手说：等九鼎聚齐。然后她叫了一个名字。不是我的。
text.en: I remember a third thing. The water I was laid in was salt — the sea, this sea. The hand said: wait until the nine are gathered. Then she spoke a name. Not mine.

label.en: Take the cauldron's breath · The Nascent Soul

exits.means: touches the cauldron, takes its breath, attempts the breakthrough

refuse.zh: 鼎气涌上来又退开。结丹未满，装不下。先回人间，把功课做满。
refuse.en: The breath surges over you and draws back. Your Core is not yet full enough to hold it. Go back to the world and fill your practice first.

text.zh: 海从九面涌来，一浪一浪打进丹田。你站住了。丹裂开，里面坐着一个婴儿大小的你。鼎小了，小到握在掌心，和冀鼎、兖鼎并排。
text.en: The sea comes from nine sides, wave after wave into your dantian. You stay standing. The Core splits, and inside sits a you the size of an infant. The cauldron shrinks until it sits in your palm, beside the Cauldrons of Ji and Yan.

exits.means: hesitates, asks what will happen, wants to prepare first

text.zh: 潮停了四十九天。它不差这一会儿。
text.en: The tide stood for forty-nine days. It can wait a while longer.
